Microsoft Power BI

Give teams a shared view of commercial performance.

MPOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Power BI brings source data into semantic models, interactive reports, and dashboards. We can build a management scorecard that connects advertising, pipeline, finance, and operations through agreed measures. The useful deliverable is more than a set of charts: it includes calculation definitions, refresh ownership, audience access, and the drill-downs a team needs to explain a change.

Useful outputs

  • Semantic model and documented measures
  • Interactive reports and executive scorecard
  • Sharing policies and refresh operating plan

Where we can apply it

  • Growth reporting: advertising + CRM + finance → modeled measures → decision scorecard.
  • Regional operations: assigned records → secured views → performance review.
  • Data health: refresh history → freshness checks → owner escalation.
01

Use case 1

Build a leadership scorecard covering media spend, pipeline, revenue, and margin.

02

Use case 2

Create regional or owner-specific views with properly configured data security.

03

Use case 3

Monitor acquisition costs and source freshness across a reporting period.

Inputs we need

  • Authorized datasets and source owners
  • Metric dictionary and business dimensions
  • Viewer roles and refresh requirements

Delivery sequence

  • Prepare source data and agree the relationships and metric definitions.
  • Build measures, drill-down reports, and role-appropriate views.
  • Reconcile calculations and test refresh schedules and viewer permissions.

Expert review points

  • Check measures against finance or CRM source totals.
  • Test row-level security as each intended audience.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • Excel
  • SQL databases
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Supported connectors

Signals we can make visible

  • CAC
  • ROAS
  • Pipeline value
  • Gross margin
  • Data freshness

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
